title: Clean up useChatStreaming.ts — remove dead retryCountRef and type streamErrorPayload
action: Remove unused `retryCountRef = useRef(0)` at line 43. Define StreamErrorPayload interface with error_class, recoverable, retry_after fields. Replace `let streamErrorPayload: any` with `let streamErrorPayload: StreamErrorPayload | null`. Remove eslint-disable comment.

criteria: grep -c 'any' src/hooks/useChatStreaming.ts — count == 0 (or only in comments)
npx vitest run src/hooks/useChatStreaming.test.tsx — exit code 0

implementation: 1) Add `interface StreamErrorPayload { error_class: string; recoverable: boolean; retry_after: number }` before useChatStreaming function. 2) Change line 68-69 from `let streamErrorPayload: any = null` to `let streamErrorPayload: StreamErrorPayload | null = null`. 3) Remove `retryCountRef` declaration and any references. 4) Remove eslint-disable comment for no-explicit-any on that line. 5) Run tests to confirm no regression.
